cosy-lesson.title: Future of Remote Work & Digital Nomads

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: telecommuting – working from home using the internet and phone

p.em: Example: Telecommuting has become widespread across tech companies.

cosy-blockquote.p: work-life balance – equilibrium between personal life and work responsibilities

p.em: Example: Maintaining a healthy work-life balance reduces burnout.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
How has remote work transformed modern business culture?
Share your personal work preference.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 teacher-student discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Discuss the following questions with your teacher:

ol.li:
How has remote work transformed modern business culture?
Share your personal work preference.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: - Create a 3-point remote work policy for an international company with your team.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Look at the prompt and discuss your response with your teacher:

cosy-blockquote.p: - Create a 3-point remote work policy for an international company with your team.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
In-office work will completely disappear within 20 years.
Debate whether you agree or disagree.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation with teacher in 1-on-1 format.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Share whether you agree or disagree with these statements and discuss them with your teacher:

ol.li:
In-office work will completely disappear within 20 years.
Debate whether you agree or disagree.

ul.li: Incorrect: It depends of company → Correct: It depends on the company (Preposition error: depend on.)

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Reflection & Feedback: Review language highlights and key corrections with your teacher.
